tools.name: health
tools.description: Health check for Father's Day Gifts. Returns ok, storage, redisPrefix (fdwl:), paapi, trackingTag (null until real Associates IDs), catalogCount, mcp, marketplaces. Peak SE Fars dag: Sunday Nov 8 2026. Prefer buyUrl/trackingTag. OpenAPI: health.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/resolve/create. Tags are omitted from links until Marcus registers real Associates IDs (tagConfigured will be false).

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for Father's Day (Fars dag) dad gifts on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise dad-gift search deep-link cards (no ?tag= until real Associates IDs) + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchGifts.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a Father's Day wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_item. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addItem.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a marketplace URL (product /dp or dad-gift search). Omits ?tag= until real Associates IDs are configured. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.
